# Checkbox

> Single checkbox control with checked and indeterminate states.

This file matches the installed `checkbox` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/checkbox.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/checkbox.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/choice-knobs`: `choiceKnobs`, types `ChoiceKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/checkbox`: `Checkbox`, types `CheckboxProps`

## Composition

### Choice control

```tsx
<Checkbox />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Checkbox } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/checkbox";
import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label";

function Row({ id, label, children }: { id: string; label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      {children}
      <Label htmlFor={id}>{label}</Label>
    </div>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveCheckboxExample() {
  const [newsletter, setNewsletter] = useState(true);
  const [parent, setParent] = useState<boolean | "indeterminate">("indeterminate");

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xs flex-col gap-4">
      <Row id="cb-news" label="Email me product news">
        <Checkbox id="cb-news" checked={newsletter} onCheckedChange={setNewsletter} aria-label="Email me product news" />
      </Row>
      <Row id="cb-mixed" label="Select all channels">
        <Checkbox
          id="cb-mixed"
          checked={parent === true}
          indeterminate={parent === "indeterminate"}
          onCheckedChange={(checked) => setParent(checked)}
          aria-label="Select all channels"
        />
      </Row>
      <Row id="cb-on" label="Checked, disabled">
        <Checkbox id="cb-on" checked disabled aria-label="Checked, disabled" />
      </Row>
      <Row id="cb-off" label="Off, disabled">
        <Checkbox id="cb-off" disabled aria-label="Off, disabled" />
      </Row>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### choice

- `--cui-choice-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-choice-indicator-size`: `calc(var(--cui-choice-size) * 0.75)`
- `--cui-choice-radius`: `var(--radius-sm)`
- `--cui-choice-border-color`: `var(--control-boundary)`
- `--cui-choice-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-choice-background`: `var(--control-fill)`
- `--cui-choice-checked-background`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-choice-checked-border-color`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-choice-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
